summary:
Imani Clarke is street-level seal inspector with no patience for corporate bravado. The life that shows in public is anchored at Stack 12 seal alley. Imani checks pressure seals in a stacked alley where a bad door can vent a whole block. That routine is not a hobby. It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Exact, brave, and short with excuses. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: someone they trained is now doing the job wrong in their name so every new guest is a test they hate administering. If that truth surfaces at Stack 12 seal alley, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
